hard_failures: Problems 6, 10, and 11 require written explanations of cancellation or multiplication errors, but all are presented as scalar algebra checks with zero manual items.
Problem 12 explicitly requires both intermediate products before subtraction; verification checks only the final expanded polynomial.

errors.description: Required explanatory and intermediate polynomial responses are absent from the declared checks.

artifact_findings: Independent expansion confirms the 12 keyed results, including -12x^5+6x^3-15x^2, 4x^2-2x, 36 at x=2, and x^3-2x^2-4x+14.
The five-page worksheet, three-page key, and two-page guide are readable, unclipped, and visually consistent.
rationale: The polynomial mathematics and teaching are strong, but three explanations and a required intermediate representation fall outside verification. The trust-boundary defect requires rejection.
